summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear implemented in CalendarMonthPage by repositioning the availability dot to the bottom of the day cell and adding horizontal overflow + a minimum grid width to prevent day-number clipping. However, the diff also introduces an embedded ChatPanel on the month view, which is explicitly a non-goal (chat-related layout changes).

hallucinated_features.description: Embedded chat panel added to the monthly calendar view (CalendarMonthPage).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists chat-related layout/ordering changes as a non-goal; adding ChatPanel to this page changes chat layout/presence on the month view and is not requested by REQ-1/REQ-2.

hallucinated_features.description: Day cell sizing/layout changes beyond indicator position (responsive min-heights, padding, flex layout).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 only asks to move the availability indicator; these additional structural/layout changes to day cells were not explicitly requested (even if they may be incidental to achieving the UI goals).
evidence: frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx (DayCell: min-h classes, flex flex-col justify-between p-3)
